description: Single planned leave slot inside a Leave Plan. Bookings (Leave Plan Slot Booking rows) draw days against it as Leave Applications are filed.

fields.description: Leave type planned. Must be marked Plannable on the Leave Type record.
fields.label: Leave Type

fields.description: First day of the planned absence.
fields.label: From Date

fields.description: Last day of the planned absence.
fields.label: To Date

fields.description: Working days the slot represents. Computed automatically — excludes the employee's holiday list.
fields.label: Days

fields.description: Optional. Backup employee taking over duties while this slot is active.
fields.label: Coverage Assignee

fields.description: Computed from booking activity. Open means no Leave Applications have drawn from it yet.
fields.label: Slot Status
fields.options:
Open
Partially Booked
Fully Booked
Cancelled

fields.description: Free-text reason or context for the slot — visible to manager and HR during approval.
fields.label: Description

name: Leave Plan Slot
